7692.title: Repeated pending-buffer byte accounting
7692.rootCauseOneLine: The stream reader remeasures the full accumulated line after each chunk, giving quadratic byte-accounting work for fixed-size chunks.

prReviews.topFinding: The incremental-accounting approach targets the verified cause; its branch was not run and the added case does not prove a linear-work bound.

7692.proposedFix: Measure newly decoded tails once, maintain a byte total, and reset at line and discard boundaries. Do not open a duplicate of existing PR #7699.
7692.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts. Timing is environment-specific. Full baseline suite has eight Claude permission-contract failures; full build hit missing SDK dist entries. Focused reader tests pass.
